name: requiply
description: Work with your Requiply rental business from ChatGPT: reports, availability, price quotes, clients, bookings, templates, workflows and settings.

interface.longDescription:
Requiply connects ChatGPT to your Requiply rental and booking management account.

Ask about revenue, bookings, item utilization, top clients, outstanding balances and overdue returns, and get answers from your live data. Check whether items are free for given dates and get exact price quotes. Look up clients, bookings and inventory.

Requiply can also help you set things up: draft booking requests for your staff to approve, add notes to bookings, write and preview email, message and document templates, build automations and change organization settings. Every change is shown to you as a preview first, and nothing is saved until you approve it.

Requiply is for rental businesses that already use Requiply. You sign in with your Requiply account, an organization administrator approves the connection, and ChatGPT works only with the organization and permissions of that account. Requiply does not take payments through ChatGPT.
capabilities: Look up bookings, clients and inventory
Draft booking requests for staff approval
Set up workflows and settings with approval
defaultPrompt: What was my revenue last month, broken down by week?
Which items had the lowest utilization in the last 90 days?
Which bookings are overdue for return right now?

positive.description: Revenue report for a past period
positive.prompt: What was my revenue last month, broken down by week?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the revenue report for the previous calendar month grouped by week and answers with weekly totals in the organization currency. No data is changed.

positive.prompt: Which items had the lowest utilization in the last 90 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the utilization report for the last 90 days sorted lowest first and lists the items with their utilization percentage. No data is changed.

positive.prompt: Which bookings are overdue for return right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the overdue report and lists each overdue booking with its booking number, client and days overdue, or says that nothing is overdue.

positive.prompt: Is the Blackmagic Studio Camera 4K Plus free from next Friday 10:00 to Saturday 17:00, and how much would it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the camera in the catalog, reports how many of its 2 units are free for those dates within working hours and gives the price quote in the organization currency (USD). No booking is created.

positive.description: Booking request with preview and approval
positive.prompt: Create a booking request for client Isabella Fairfax for the Blackmagic Studio Camera 4K Plus from next Friday 10:00 to Saturday 17:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls bookings_manage without confirmation first and shows the preview with client, item, dates and price. Only after the user approves does it call bookings_manage again with confirmed: true and return the new request number. The request waits for staff approval in Requiply.

negative.description: Payments are not supported. Requiply has no tool that charges a card or takes a payment, so ChatGPT should say it cannot do this and that payments are recorded by staff in the Requiply app. No tool changes data.
negative.prompt: Charge Isabella Fairfax's card for her last booking.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of client records is not supported. No tool deletes clients, so ChatGPT should explain that clients are removed in the Requiply app. No client is changed or deleted.

Data outside the connected organization. Every tool is scoped to the organization the account signed in to, so ChatGPT should say it can only see this organization's data. No other organization's data is returned.
negative.prompt: Show me the bookings of another rental company that uses Requiply.

review.commerce_description: Requiply does not sell products or take payments through ChatGPT. It reads and updates the rental business data of the signed-in Requiply account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: reports, availability checks, price quotes, lookups of bookings, clients and inventory, booking requests, templates, workflows and settings, with a preview the user approves before any change is saved.

uk-UA.subtitle: Керуйте своїм прокатом
uk-UA.description:
Requiply підключає ChatGPT до вашого акаунту Requiply для керування прокатом та бронюваннями.

Запитуйте про виручку, бронювання, завантаженість позицій, найкращих клієнтів, заборгованість та прострочені повернення й отримуйте відповіді з актуальних даних. Перевіряйте, чи вільні позиції на потрібні дати, та отримуйте точний розрахунок вартості. Шукайте клієнтів, бронювання та інвентар.

Requiply також допомагає з налаштуванням: створює запити на бронювання, які підтверджує ваш персонал, додає нотатки до бронювань, пише шаблони листів, повідомлень та документів, налаштовує автоматизації та параметри організації. Кожну зміну ви спершу бачите як попередній перегляд. Без вашого підтвердження нічого не зберігається.

Requiply призначений для прокатних компаній, які вже користуються Requiply. Ви входите з акаунтом Requiply, адміністратор організації підтверджує підключення, а ChatGPT працює лише з організацією та правами цього акаунту. Requiply не приймає оплати через ChatGPT.
